source.name: Rattled
source.originalDescription: When damaged, increases movement speed by 5% for 3s (up to 5 times; maximum 25%). Increases the effort gauge each time Magikarp uses an auto attack or move, hits with an auto attack or move, scores a goal, knocks out a Pokémon from the opposing team or assists in knocking out a Pokémon from the opposing team. Once the effort gauge is full, Magikarp evolves into Gyarados. When damaged, increases movement speed by 5% for 3s (up to 5 times; maximum 25%).
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Rattled は 移動速度を上げる、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、KOまたはアシストで発動する。

source.name: Dragon Current
source.originalDescription: Becomes untargetable and dives underwater for up to 4s while this Unite Move is held, increasing movement speed by 45%. When released or after 4s, forcefully leaps up and attacks, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. The longer the move is held, the larger the area of effect becomes. If the user stays underwater for at least 1s before releasing the Unite Move, strengthens the movement speed increase to 55%; deals increased damage and creates a whirlpool where they surface, dealing damage over time to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect (up to 5 times) and decreasing their movement speed for 4s when hit. If underwater for at least 2s, strengthens the movement speed increase to 65%; deals even more damage and creates a waterspout where they surface instead, throwing opposing Pokémon hit for 1s. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Dragon Current は 相手を打ち上げる、移動速度を下げる、対象指定されない、またはステルス状態になる、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する、継続ダメージを与える。
